about_the_game:
If you are a fan of "KeepUp Survival" and would like to support me as a solo developer, you can purchase this optional Supporter Pack and join me on my gamedev journey!

This DLC Pack includes:

  • An exclusive symbol in the main menu to show your support

  • A decorative figure in the main menu as a small thank-you gift

  • A supporter icon displayed next to your player name in multiplayer mode

  • This Supporter Pack marks your version of KeepUp Survival as the Supporter Edition in the main menu.

Note: This Supporter Pack is entirely optional and has no impact on gameplay. It is a small thank-you for players who wish to further support the development of KeepUp Survival.
